eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients 18 years or older
* Patients who are undergoing in-office levator muscle trigger point injection for myofascial pelvic pain
* Able to give informed consent for the study

Exclusion Criteria:

* Documented allergy to lidocaine or prilocaine
* Use of lidocaine or prilocaine within last 72 hours

identificationModule.briefTitle: Lidocaine-prilocaine Cream as Analgesia for In-office Levator Muscle Trigger Point Injections
